articles.title: A Baked Bean Tie and a Doctor to the Rescue: Wild Moments from the UK Elections
articles.summary: Election night can be serious, but it also had a candidate dressed as a baked bean superhero and a doctor saving a rival who collapsed. Even politicians need a laugh and a helping hand.

articles.title: Happy 100th Birthday to David Attenborough, the Voice of the Wild!
articles.summary: David Attenborough turns 100 today. He's the famous nature presenter who showed us gorillas, whales, and tiny frogs—and taught us to protect our planet.

articles.title: What Happens to Spirit Airlines' Yellow Planes Now That It's Closed?
articles.summary: Spirit Airlines stopped flying, leaving over 90 bright yellow planes parked at airports. Now, a race is on to move them—and some pilots face airport police just to get onboard.
